purpose: Define the benchmark-safe evidence-router v0 contract that combines Foldseek, sequence similarity, geometry, cofactor/ligand evidence, learned representations, evidence tier policy, and abstention without changing production scoring or labels.

allowed_now: define benchmark and panel evaluation plan

diagnostic_router_pilot.role: prior Foldseek plus geometry diagnostic router prototype

wave1_structure_neighborhood_audit.role: joined Wave 1 row evidence and representation tracks

foldseek_coordinate_readiness.role: Foldseek coordinate availability and readiness limits

geometry_retrieval.role: geometry-aware retrieval metadata and leakage policy

cofactor_coverage.role: cofactor support, absence, and evidence-limited abstention inventory

cofactor_policy.role: audit-only cofactor policy sweep and recommendation

learned_retrieval_manifest.role: learned-retrieval interface eligibility and review-only training-label rule

external_source_transfer_gate_check.role: external-source gate state and artifact lineage

external_stress_panel_roadmap.role: external panel admission rules and target families

fmo_external_hard_negative_duplicate_gat.role: FMO hard-negative duplicate and admission guardrails

design_summary.router_contract: A row-level state router that consumes frozen channel outputs and emits a card-compatible route, abstention, and metric policy without producing a new mechanism score.
design_summary.primary_design_choice: The router chooses a primary router_state_id plus optional secondary flags, because cofactor mismatch, acquisition needs, and expert review can overlap with structural-transfer states.
design_summary.evidence_combination_rule: Channels are normalized to support, conflict, abstain, missing, or review-only signals; state assignment is deterministic and precedence-based, not threshold-tuned in this artifact.
known_wave1_1_findings_used: Foldseek is strong in dense same-mechanism neighborhoods.
Foldseek makes unsafe transfers in close-structure different-mechanism rows.
Geometry resolves the existing near-orphan and wrong-Foldseek-transfer diagnostic slices.
Learned representations add limited signal in wrong-transfer cells but do not replace geometry or Foldseek.
No row-aligned Foldseek-pocket export is available locally.
Review-only and child-label cells are not countable metrics.

must_not_use_at_prediction_time: row membership in a handpicked success or failure list except as pre-frozen review-only evaluation context

states.definition: A row has a close Foldseek or structural-neighborhood neighbor whose frozen label family is consistent with active-site geometry and cofactor/ligand evidence.

result_contract.metric_use: countable only if the target row and source label are already countable under the frozen split

states.wave1_1_reference: Dense same-mechanism structural-neighborhood rows where Foldseek and geometry agree.

states.definition: A row has a close structural neighbor, but the structural transfer crosses a primary-family, OOS, secondary-boundary, or cofactor-locus boundary and conflicts with geometry or cofactor evidence.

result_contract.metric_use: unsafe_nonabstention diagnostic on pre-frozen Wave 1.1 conflict slices only

states.wave1_1_reference: Packet 2 wrong-Foldseek-transfer behavior: Foldseek 0/4 correct with 4/4 unsafe nonabstentions, geometry 4/4 rescue.

states.definition: A row lacks a reliable close same-mechanism structural neighbor, but source-free active-site geometry and cofactor/ligand evidence support a parent mechanism family.

result_contract.claim_scope: diagnostic parent-family support unless evidence tier permits countable use
result_contract.metric_use: review-only near-orphan rescue slice unless the row was countable before split freeze

states.wave1_1_reference: Packet 2 near-orphan geometry-rescue behavior: geometry supports 17/17, Foldseek supports 13/17 with 4 abstentions.

states.definition: The row lacks a supported selected PDB or AlphaFold structure, has failed or excluded coordinate materialization, or cannot join to Foldseek/geometry channels.

result_contract.metric_use: coverage denominator and acquisition backlog; not a positive or negative route metric

states.wave1_1_reference: No reliable structure rows in the diagnostic router pilot and Foldseek readiness exclusions.

states.definition: The candidate mechanism requires a local cofactor, metal, ligand, substrate analog, or ligand state that is absent, structure-wide only, incompatible, or routed to the wrong catalytic locus.

result_contract.claim_scope: no positive mechanism claim until local cofactor or ligand-state support is resolved
result_contract.metric_use: separate evidence-limited stratum; do not tune penalties from this artifact

states.wave1_1_reference: Cofactor coverage and policy artifacts recommend audit-only handling of evidence-limited retained positives.

states.definition: The router can support a broad parent fingerprint but the child mechanism, sublabel, or mixed-chemistry split is not countable, underpowered, proposal-only, blocked, or absent from the production ontology.
required_signals: child_target.status in [proposal_only, blocked, unresolved, underpowered, not_in_production]

result_contract.claim_scope: parent projection only; no child-label accuracy claim
result_contract.metric_use: pilot-only or abstention-probe slice, never canonical child metric in v0

states.wave1_1_reference: Packet 3 child strata, unresolved buckets, canaries, and mixed-chemistry blocked cells.

states.definition: The row is outside the frozen mechanism universe or is a pre-registered hard negative where a positive route would be a regression.
required_signals: positive route would cross the frozen admission rules

result_contract.claim_scope: negative control or OOS boundary only
result_contract.metric_use: hard-negative or OOS regression only when pre-registered and countable; otherwise review-only

states.wave1_1_reference: OOS boundary abstention rows, m_csa:497 and m_csa:750 read-through handling, FMO hard-negative gates, and external hard-negative threshold policy.

states.definition: A row could become evaluable only after missing structure, sequence, active-site residue, ligand-state, cofactor, Foldseek, representation, duplicate-screen, or expert-source evidence is acquired.
required_signals: missing evidence is resolvable by a defined acquisition task
current evidence is insufficient for a safe positive or negative route
states.wave1_1_reference: External transfer blocker matrix and Foldseek coordinate readiness blockers.

states.definition: The machine-readable evidence is complete enough to show a decision point, but admissibility, child assignment, boundary interpretation, or external transfer requires human review before any countable use.
required_signals: or route_decision would alter benchmark semantics without a frozen expert decision

result_contract.metric_use: excluded from countable metrics until a future pre-registered expert-reviewed import path permits use

states.wave1_1_reference: Packet 3 proposal-only sublabels and external mechanism-match review-ready rows.

row_identity.predictive_use: identity fields are join keys only and must not add positive score or select a mechanism.

channels.purpose: Capture full-structure nearest-neighbor and structural-neighborhood evidence.
allowed_predictive_features: Foldseek or TM-align similarity values from a frozen run
alignment coverage and chain mapping completeness
nearest-neighbor label group from the frozen training split

channels.purpose: Capture exact duplicate, near-duplicate, and sequence-nearest-neighbor evidence.
prohibited_predictive_features: source database identity as a mechanism feature

channels.purpose: Capture source-free active-site geometry, residue-role, and pocket evidence.
prohibited_predictive_features: target labels except as frozen supervised labels in train split
review-only text counterevidence as positive support

channels.purpose: Separate local cofactor and ligand-state support from structure-wide or absent evidence.
allowed_predictive_features: metal and cofactor family inference from local coordinates
structure-wide cofactor inventory as a blocker or evidence-limited flag
ligand-state compatibility when derived from coordinates or preregistered extractors
prohibited_predictive_features: structure-wide cofactor as local active-site support

channels.purpose: Carry frozen row-aligned learned-model outputs as comparison or auxiliary evidence.
allowed_predictive_features: frozen model confidence fields when already emitted
prohibited_predictive_features: larger-model reruns for this v0 contract
using missing model output as positive mechanism evidence

channels.purpose: Gate metric eligibility and review actions without acting as positive mechanism evidence.
allowed_predictive_features: none; this channel is a gate and metric policy channel
prohibited_predictive_features: treating high tier as mechanism evidence
using review status to choose a positive family
using expert rationale text as a score feature

channels.purpose: Carry frozen abstention decisions and reasons from each channel into the router card.
allowed_predictive_features: precomputed score margins from frozen artifacts for explanation only
hard-negative and OOS gate flags from pre-registered policies
prohibited_predictive_features: using review-only outcomes to fit abstention

review_source_context.purpose: Carry provenance and human-readable context for audit, expert review, and source acquisition only.
review_source_context.policy: Review/source context may explain or queue a row, but it must not add positive route support, tune thresholds, or create countable labels.

tier_definitions.definition: Expert-reviewed countable label with direct admissible rationale under the frozen ontology.
tier_definitions.metric_policy: Eligible for countable evaluation or calibration only when present before split freeze and not excluded by duplicate, leakage, or panel rules.
tier_definitions.training_policy: Eligible as high-quality supervised label if the future training plan permits it.

tier_definitions.definition: Expert-reviewed or strongly supported countable label that passes current label-factory evidence checks.
tier_definitions.metric_policy: Eligible for countable evaluation when present before split freeze; report separately from bronze in sensitive slices.
tier_definitions.training_policy: Eligible as supervised label under future frozen training plans.

tier_definitions.definition: Automation-curated countable label with weaker evidence or default migrated status.
tier_definitions.metric_policy: Eligible only in already-frozen countable metrics; not sufficient by itself for new child metrics, external transfer claims, or gold/silver validation claims.
tier_definitions.training_policy: Weak supervision only unless a future plan promotes or stratifies it.

tier_definitions.definition: Diagnostic, proposal-only, sourcing, no-decision, blocked, or expert-review-needed row.
tier_definitions.metric_policy: Excluded from countable accuracy, calibration, threshold selection, and training. It may appear only in review-only diagnostic slices, acquisition queues, hard-negative audits, and result-card explanations.

external_provenance_tiers.metric_policy: May be countable only if already in the canonical registry and not specifically marked review-only or control-only.
Future validation-only candidate after active-site evidence, sequence controls, Foldseek controls, terminal review, and non-import gates are frozen.
Sourcing backlog only; excluded from metrics and training.
Hard-negative, OOS, exact-overlap, near-duplicate, or mismatch control. Count only in pre-registered rejection/abstention metrics; otherwise review-only.

metric_inclusion_rules: Countable Wave 1 metrics may include only rows countable before split freeze under the existing metric contract.
Wave 1.1 Packet 2 and Packet 3 rows remain review-only unless an existing artifact already marks the source metric as countable.
Gold and silver anchors may be stratified as high-confidence evaluation rows, but this design does not create or import any.
Bronze rows may remain in existing frozen primary/OOS metrics, but they cannot define new child-label metrics.
Review-only rows are excluded from accuracy, macro-F1, threshold calibration, training, and production score claims.
External panel rows are validation contracts only until a future pre-registered packet marks a row as tier_B_external_curated or a countable control.
metric_exclusion_rules: Do not count proposal-only child labels as correct child predictions.
Do not count acquisition-needed rows as false negatives unless they were already countable and evaluable in the frozen metric.
Do not use review-only external positives to tune thresholds or select model channels.
Do not treat exact M-CSA overlaps or near duplicates as external positives.
Do not aggregate OOS/hard-negative rejection success with positive-family accuracy without a separate denominator.

field_contract.entry_id: Stable row identifier used only for joins and display.
field_contract.secondary_flags: Zero or more non-primary blockers or diagnostics.
field_contract.route_decision: One of transfer_supported, geometry_supported_candidate_or_abstain_pending_tier, parent_support_only_child_abstain, reject_or_abstain, abstain_or_review, acquire_evidence_then_reroute, expert_review_queue, no_claim.
field_contract.abstained: True when no positive production-compatible mechanism claim is emitted.
field_contract.abstention_reason: Short machine-readable reason such as fold_conflict, oos_hard_negative, cofactor_mismatch, child_unresolved, no_reliable_structure, acquisition_needed, or review_only.
field_contract.candidate_mechanism: Parent fingerprint or child label candidate, with claim_scope and no_score fields. Null when no candidate is safe.
field_contract.input_channels: Normalized channel payloads defined by input_channel_contract.
field_contract.metric_policy: Countable/review-only decision, evidence tier, allowed metric slices, and exclusion reason.
field_contract.review_source_context: Human-readable source and review metadata excluded from positive route scoring.
field_contract.source_artifacts: Artifact refs and hashes needed to reproduce the card.

metric_policy_shape.metric_use_allowed_now: countable_existing_metric | review_only_diagnostic_slice | pilot_only_review_slice | abstention_probe_only | hard_negative_regression_only | coverage_only | excluded

prohibited_metrics: review-only rows counted as validation labels

minimum_panel_inputs_before_routing: explicit row IDs and panel role
sequence-neighbor screen against current countable references
selected active-state structure or explicit no-structure status
Foldseek-neighbor check against current countable and OOS controls
source-free active-site and cofactor/ligand extraction where available
prohibited_metrics: external positive accuracy before tier_B admission
promoting tier_C sourcing backlog into validation
success_criteria: hard negatives do not receive target positive routes because of shared fold, cofactor, ligand, metal, O2, PLP, heme, glycan, or name context
incomplete external rows route to acquisition_needed or expert_review_needed rather than positive claims
clean external positives are evaluated only after evidence tier, duplicate, sequence, Foldseek, active-site, and non-import gates are frozen
result cards preserve review/source context separately from predictive channel evidence

principles: Implement as a read-only artifact join first.
Use frozen artifacts and precomputed channel outputs.
Emit no production score and tune no threshold.
Keep review/source context physically separate from predictive channel payloads.
Version the schema before any future change to state precedence or metric eligibility.

steps.name: Define typed JSON schema or dataclasses
steps.deliverable: RouterInputRow, RouterChannelPayload, RouterStateCard, and RouterAggregateCard interfaces.

steps.name: Build read-only channel adapters
steps.deliverable: Adapters for Wave 1.1 structure audit, Foldseek readiness, geometry retrieval, cofactor coverage/policy, sequence/learned tracks, and external panel manifests.

steps.name: Implement deterministic state assignment
steps.deliverable: Precedence-based state mapping using channel_status values and metric_policy gates only.

steps.name: Emit review-only router cards
steps.deliverable: Per-row cards plus aggregate result-card sections for Wave 1.1 cells.

steps.name: Add leakage tests
steps.deliverable: Tests that names, EC/Rhea identifiers, source ids, mechanism prose, expert notes, and review rationale are absent from predictive channel payloads.

steps.name: Add metric-scope tests
steps.deliverable: Tests that review-only, proposal-only, external tier_C, and blocked child rows cannot become countable metrics through the router.

steps.name: Run Wave 1.1 replay
steps.deliverable: Review-only result card comparing state counts and unsafe nonabstentions to the existing model-by-cell report.

steps.name: Prepare external panel replay
steps.deliverable: Panel cards only after sequence, Foldseek, active-site, cofactor/ligand, evidence-tier, and duplicate-control inputs are complete.
blocked_by: external representation controls not computed for all lanes
terminal review decisions not complete for every external row

non_claims: This artifact is not a router implementation.
This artifact is not a production scoring policy.
This artifact does not change Foldseek, geometry, sequence, learned, or cofactor outputs.
This artifact does not claim learned representations outperform Foldseek or geometry.
This artifact does not make review-only rows countable.
This artifact does not authorize external label import.
